'''Telaisien''' was the seventh [[Queen of Andor|Queen]] of [[Andor]], succeeding Queen [[Astara]] in {{Fy|1085}}. It is not known if Telaisien was Astara's daughter, but it is known that she was also a descendant of Queen [[Ishara Casalain]], the founder of the kingdom of Andor.

== History ==
Circa {{Fy|1090}}, during the [[War of the Hundred Years]], a southern noblewoman named [[Esmara Getares]] succeeded in conquering much of [[Illian]] and the [[Plains of Maredo]] before invading Andor from the south. Although Esmara's successes indicate the forces she brought into Andor must have been significant, they were defeated in battle with the Andoran army. Getares was captured and spent the final twelve years of her life as a 'guest' of Queen Telaisien. She died by assassination, for reasons unknown.

Telaisien ruled for eighteen years (FY 1085 - [[FY 1103|1103]]) and was succeeded by Queen [[Morrigan]].
